English-Русский FreeDict+WikDict dictionary, version 2025.11.23
Русский-English FreeDict+WikDict dictionary, version 2025.11.23

Publisher and maintainer: Karl Bartel
The bilingual dictionaries were automatically created by WikDict:
http://www.wikdict.com/
Base data comes from Wiktionary via DBnary:
https://www.wiktionary.org/
http://kaiko.getalp.org/about-dbnary/

Sources:
https://download.freedict.org/generated/eng-rus/eng-rus.tei
https://download.freedict.org/generated/rus-eng/rus-eng.tei

Project: https://freedict.org/
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported
License text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/legalcode

The data was transformed into compact JSON files split by translation direction
and first letter. U+0301 stress marks and source markup were removed for display.
The transformed data is distributed under the same CC BY-SA 3.0 terms.

Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 are distributed under the
Apache License 2.0: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js

English and Russian OCR language packages @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 and
@tesseract.js-data/rus 1.0.0 declare MIT in their npm package metadata.
The bundled 4.0.0_best_int models are based on tessdata_best, whose source
repository licenses all its trained models under Apache License 2.0:
https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best

The complete Apache License 2.0 text and the worker's third-party notices
are included under the extension's ocr/ directory. OCR files are bundled
locally; the extension does not load them from a CDN at runtime.

Mozilla PDF.js 6.3.289 (`pdfjs-dist`) is distributed under the Apache License
2.0: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

The PDF.js library and module worker are bundled locally. The complete Apache
License 2.0 text is included under the extension's pdf/ directory.
